mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u.username as upload_username, u.nickname as upload_nickname, u.avatar_url as upload_avatar, c.name as category_name FROM resource r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.upload_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON r.category_id = c.id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT r.*, u.username as upload_username, u.nickname as upload_nickname, u.avatar_url as upload_avatar, c.name as category_name FROM resource r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.upload_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON r.category_id = c.id WHERE r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.view_count DESC, r.like_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.*, u.username as upload_username, u.nickname as upload_nickname, u.avatar_url as upload_avatar, c.name as category_name FROM resource r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.upload_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON r.category_id = c.id WHERE r.upload_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
